summary: This excerpt from a novel (Book 11, part 125) describes the morning of a graduation day in a small town. Girls curl their hair with leads or rags and mothers fan their daughters while they wait for the ten o'clock signal, and the dresses are described in Swiss muslin, cashmere, alpaca and cheesecloth. Rebecca makes her graduating dress from cheesecloth from the Perkins attic, aided by Emma Jane, Hannah, Mrs. Cobb and aunt Jane, and the girls' final day together brings tears and mixed feelings. Rebecca has been offered two positions by Mr. Morrison, and the first bell calls the class to the church for the exercises.
one_line: On graduation morning, Rebecca and Emma Jane prepare their cheesecloth dresses and face the end of their close friendship before the class heads to church.
key_facts: Rebecca's graduating dress was made from white butter-muslin or cheesecloth found in the Perkins attic, which she decided would do.
Rebecca and Emma Jane visited the Perkins attic together about a month before graduation.
The blacksmith's daughter abandoned the idea of dotted Swiss and followed Rebecca in cheesecloth.
Rebecca's dress was finished in sections: the sash went to Hannah, the waist and sleeves to Mrs. Cobb, and the skirt to aunt Jane.
The cheesecloth material cost only three or four pennies a yard.
Mothers waved palm-leaf fans over their daughters while the girls' hair was in leads or papers, until the town clock struck ten.
Some girls substituted rags for leads, claiming a more natural and less woolly curl.
Dotted or plain Swiss muslin was the favorite garb, while some wore white cashmere or alpaca.
Mr. Morrison offered Rebecca two positions the day before graduation.
One offered position was playing for singing and calisthenics and superintending piano practice of younger girls in a boarding-school.
The other offered position was an assistant's place in the Edgewood High School.
Miss Maxwell thought the boarding-school position's educational advantages might be valuable.
Emma Jane was in a tearful state because the girls' close intimacy was ending.
The first bell announced that in five minutes the class would proceed in a body to the church for the exercises.
